Summary: Wraps around the json module to strip whitespace from payloads.

Description: Created to provide a convenient way to load and dump JSON data with compact formatting. Used by various parts of the system to ensure consistent JSON handling.

@staticmethod
def loads(payload: str | bytes) -> t.Any:
    """Loads a JSON payload and returns the deserialized object.

    Args:
        payload (str | bytes): The JSON payload to be loaded.

    Returns:
        t.Any: The deserialized object.
    """
    return _json.loads(payload)

@staticmethod
def dumps(obj: t.Any, **kwargs: t.Any) -> str:
    """Dumps an object to a compact JSON string.

    Args:
        obj (t.Any): The object to be serialized.
        kwargs (t.Any): Additional keyword arguments to pass to json.dumps.

    Returns:
        str: The compact JSON string representation of the object.
    """
    kwargs.setdefault("ensure_ascii", False)
    kwargs.setdefault("separators", (",", ":"))
    return _json.dumps(obj, **kwargs)
